title: Dancing Dragon - Signed Studio Print
summary: One signed, unframed studio print on 8.5 x 11-inch paper.
description:
A signed, open-edition print of Dancing Dragon, an original artwork by Santiago Salvador. Printed to order in my home studio on high-quality inkjet paper.

You receive one physical, unframed print on an 8.5 x 11-inch sheet, with a white border. The image measures approximately 6.0 x 9.0 inches; the full composition is preserved. Signed by the artist.

The listing image is a digital artwork preview, not a photograph of a finished print. Colors may vary between screens and paper. No digital download or frame is included.

Made to order. Dispatch within 5-7 business days after payment. Ships flat in protective packaging. U.S. shipping: $7; each additional print in the same order: $1. International customers: contact salvsantiago@gmail.com with your country, postal code, and selected artwork for a shipping quote before purchasing. No frame or digital download is included.
paper: High-quality inkjet paper; finish chosen after local proofing
